review:
A 10-line Egyptian game on PowerNudge: winning reels nudge down, giving the next symbols a chance to win too.

Scarab scatters land as overlays, and three trigger free spins. In the bonus, a multiplier starts and grows by 1x with every nudge and every spin after, so long sequences get steadily more valuable. 96.49% RTP. Simple line slot, one feature that keeps building.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
